Clarke, won second prize at the renowned Chelsea
Flower Show for his display “Hands Off Mangrove.”
His intent was to center issues of deforestation and social
justice, it featured a pollinator-friendly garden designed
to be relocated to inner-city London. The display was
emblematic of Clarke’s mission: making green spaces
Calling himself “The Black Gardener” to highlight
the lack of diversity in his profession, Clarke uses his
platform as host of a popular gardening show to share
his philosophy that access to nature is not a privilege
